published_ranges._notes: TDS 'THE K6 PLA CF10' rev 04, 20/02/2025; settings based on a 0.4mm nozzle. Carbon-fibre filled (CF10 in the name); the TDS does not state a hardened-nozzle requirement. Also 2.85mm (+/-0.03). Density is a range, so filament_density left unset. No drying spec published.
